question: How far does an agent get on real unseen computer-use pages with ZERO experience, ZERO search, ZERO reward reads and no external model?

protocol.source: MiniWoB++ html/ in a real chromium substrate
protocol.experience: none - a fresh ContractArm per page, nothing carried between pages or episodes
protocol.reward: never read by the agent; scored by the harness after the episode

result.note: every increase came from a page-agnostic structural law, never from naming a page

laws_measured_this_round.law: A FROZEN INDEX IS NOT AN ACTION, AND NEITHER IS A FROZEN LABEL
laws_measured_this_round.evidence: ascending-numbers: pressing the first number replaces every remaining number with a blank rect at that number's own coordinates; the page also renumbers its elements. Text can never resolve again, so identity must be positional - and the ledger must be written positionally too, or the same target is served twice and the next can never be found.

laws_measured_this_round.law: WHERE A THING IS COUNTS AS OBSERVED STATE
laws_measured_this_round.evidence: the repeat guard hashed text/tag/value only, so a page that had become a different arrangement of blank rects read as unchanged and the arm re-pressed the same element forever. Geometry is part of the observable.

laws_measured_this_round.law: A SUBMENU HEADER IS HOVERED, NOT CLICKED
laws_measured_this_round.evidence: click-menu: clicking 'Milissent' ended the episode (done=True) with the trail unpressed; hovering opened the next level. The page says which it is: the header carries a caret icon its leaf siblings do not.

laws_measured_this_round.law: A WIDGET'S ORIENTATION IS ITS TRACK'S, NOT ITS HANDLE'S
laws_measured_this_round.evidence: use-slider: the handle is a 14x14 square and says nothing about the axis; the container holding it is 10x99. Vertical sliders invert - 'up' raised the value 107 to 110.

laws_measured_this_round.law: NEVER ACT ON HALF AN INSTRUCTION
laws_measured_this_round.evidence: circle-center / find-midpoint / resize-textarea were being executed using only their decidable 'press submit' half; the arm now emits no action when any part of the instruction was refused.

acted_but_failed.reading: 16 of 28 are not vocabulary gaps: the instruction names something the page never shows as an element (a calendar, a colour region, prose, a prefix family) or needs the environment's hidden state. Only 12 are execution errors on pages the arm did understand.

what_this_measures_about_the_claim.instant_learning: true only as a version space over a stated language; here the language is the operator set in instruction_contract_v1.py, and the arm solves 58.2% of the pages it can parse having never seen a page before
what_this_measures_about_the_claim.learning_versus_coverage: zero experience reaches 30.0% and the binding constraint is contract coverage and observation content, not experience: 63 pages produced no contract at all while 39 were solved with no experience whatsoever
what_this_measures_about_the_claim.arbitrary_environments: bounded drift only; what breaks this arm is a page whose target has no name in the DOM - no amount of experience supplies a name that is not there
what_this_measures_about_the_claim.computer_use_and_swe: frontier numbers on OSWorld 2.0 (20.6-31.4%) sit in the same band as this arm's 30.0% on a far easier benchmark; that is the honest scale of what remains
what_this_measures_about_the_claim.bottleneck: the causal observable / verifier - what the agent cannot do is see enough of the world to check itself
